text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The venue erupted with tremendous 
excitement at this once-in-a-century clash 
between Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The match of the century, drawing the 
public's full attention. The atmosphere 
inside the venue swelled with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu is certain that today will 
be the ultimate race. The audience, the 
atmosphere, the rivals... and the Trainer. 
Everything is perfectly in place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, no more words are needed. In a 
supreme race where everything is 
immaculate, Mejiro Ramonu runs to offer 
her love—
